relationships.subject: circ_0005075
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of circ_0005075 repressed thebehaviors of neuropathic pain including mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: circ_0005075
relationships.evidence_quote: We displayed that miR-151a-3p was greatly reduced in CCI rats and circ_0005075 reversed the repressive effect of miR-151a-3p on neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: miR-151a-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, circ_0005075 significantly rescued NOTCH2 expression, which could be repressed by miR-151a-3p.

relationships.subject: circ_0005075
relationships.evidence_quote: loss of circ_0005075 could repress the neuroinflammation via targeting COX-2, IL-6 and TNF-α whereas inducing IL-10 in vivo

key_findings: circ_0005075 is increased in CCI rats and its knockdown relieves hyperalgesia and neuroinflammation
circ_0005075 acts through miR-151a-3p and NOTCH2
